doctoral: 博士及其他博士學位課程（GRS官方）
umtra: UM PhD Teaching Research Assistant（GRS官方）
hengqin: 橫琴第一期辦學安排（GRS官方）
plan: 澳大五年發展規劃（2026/27至2030/31學年）

questions.q: 下列哪項最準確描述研究生院與學術單位在研究生教育中的角色？
choices: 研究生院統籌研究生教育的管理、發展和評估，並與學術單位協作
研究生院主要負責招生宣傳，研究生學籍及教育發展完全由各學院統籌
研究生院專責博士生資助，碩士課程管理及質素評估歸各學院獨立處理
questions.why: 研究生院不只負責招生或獎助金，也統籌研究生教育的管理、發展與評估，並與學術單位協作。

questions.q: 研究生院公開的行政聯絡分工，哪一組最準確？
choices: 招生及推廣、學生住宿管理、國際學術交流
招生及推廣、學籍管理、課程及學術支援
招生及推廣、學籍管理、科研項目經費管理
questions.why: 官方聯絡分工包括招生及推廣、學籍管理、課程及學術支援。住宿、國際交流及科研經費與之相關，但不是此處列出的三組。

questions.q: 研究生院官方網站列出的統一查詢電郵是哪一個？
choices: grs.enquiry@um.edu.mo
graduate.school@um.edu.mo
gradschool@um.edu.mo
questions.why: GRS網站列明 gradschool@um.edu.mo；其他兩個雖然形式相似，並非該頁列出的聯絡地址。

questions.q: 按研究生院的公開課程資訊，哪一組課程層次最完整？
choices: 博士、碩士及部分學士後證書／文憑課程
博士、研究型碩士及全部本科學士課程
博士、授課型碩士及學士學位課程
questions.why: 研究生院的招生課程資訊涵蓋博士、碩士及學士後證書／文憑；本科學士並非其研究生招生範疇。

questions.q: 一名持有碩士學位的申請人希望循澳大博士課程的「普通入學」途徑報名。哪項學歷要求正確？
choices: 持學士學位並有突出研究能力即可按普通入學報名
持碩士學位或澳大認可的同等學術背景
在澳大碩士課程註冊至少一年並完成課程部分
questions.why: 普通入學途徑面向碩士學位或認可同等學歷持有人；另外兩項分別更接近直接入學及加速入學條件。

questions.q: 獲合作教授表示願意考慮指導的博士申請人，下一步哪種做法最符合官方入學程序？
choices: 先由學術單位核准取錄，正式註冊時才填寫網上表格
取得導師書面同意後，直接跳過研究生院的入學申請程序
仍須在指定申請期內透過澳大網上申請系統正式提交
questions.why: 導師意向不等於正式取錄；應按公布的申請期及網上申請程序遞交。

questions.q: 按現行研究生院網站，澳大博士生獎學金UMPS適用於哪一批起入學的學生？
choices: 2023/24學年及其後入學的學生
2022/23學年及其後入學的學生
2024/25學年及其後入學的學生
questions.why: UMPS適用於2023/24學年及以後入學者；2022/23及以前入學者對應較早的獎助制度。

questions.q: 以下哪項是UMPS公布的每月津貼及最長資助期？
choices: 每月澳門元12,500，最長四年
每月澳門元20,000，最長四年
每月澳門元20,000，最長三年
questions.why: UMPS每月津貼為澳門元20,000，最長四年；澳門元12,500是另一項博士生教研助理資助的起始數額。

questions.q: 博士申請人的學術單位已提出UMPS推薦意見。根據公布安排，獎學金最終結果由誰決定？
choices: 申請人所屬學術單位的研究生委員會
研究生院的招生行政工作小組
大學層面的遴選委員會
questions.why: 學術單位可參與評估，但UMPS最終由大學層面的遴選委員會決定，且受名額限制。

questions.q: UMTRA A類的「起始」每月津貼是多少？
questions.why: UMTRA A類起始津貼為澳門元12,500；澳門元14,000是相關指引所示上限，20,000則是UMPS月額。

questions.q: UMTRA的其中一項目的，是讓獲選博士生累積哪方面的實際經驗？
choices: 課程招生甄選及大學招生審批的最終決策經驗
協助教學與研究的實務經驗
管理全校研究項目撥款及審計的經驗
questions.why: UMTRA的核心目標包括提供教學及研究輔助經驗，並不授予學生招生或經費審批權。

questions.q: 哪位申請人最符合國際碩士生獎學金所公布的基本對象？
choices: 持非澳門身份證、報讀全日制碩士的所有申請人，不論護照類別
持有效外國護照、報讀全日制行政高管碩士課程的申請人
持有效外國護照、符合入學要求並報讀全日制非行政高管類碩士的申請人
questions.why: 該獎學金以持有效外國護照、符合條件的全日制一般碩士申請人為對象，行政高管課程不在適用範圍。

questions.q: 一位持澳門居民身份證、獲錄取STEM碩士的學生查詢獎學金。哪項說明最準確？
choices: 符合條件者於招生評估時自動獲考慮，獲獎後屬一次性資助
符合條件者須每學年另交一份獎學金申請，獲獎後每月發放
符合條件者須先取得校外科研資助方可考慮，獲獎後按學期發放
questions.why: STEM碩士獎學金對合資格本地學生採自動考慮方式；獎學金為一次性，而非按月或按學期定期發放。

questions.q: 研究生院所列部分合作機構的聯合博士培養計劃，一般採用哪種四年學習安排？
choices: 首年在合作機構，其後三年在澳大
首年在澳大，其後三年在合作機構
在澳大與合作機構各修讀兩年
questions.why: 該類計劃公布的安排為首年在澳大、之後三年在合作機構；並由兩地導師共同指導。

questions.q: 研究生院所列的內地機構聯合博士培養計劃，完成註冊課程後通常由誰頒授學位？
choices: 澳大及合作機構分別頒發一個博士學位
合作機構頒授博士學位，澳大只提供聯合修課證明
澳門大學頒授博士學位
questions.why: 此類計劃屬聯合培養、雙方指導，並非必然雙學位；完成註冊課程後由澳大授博士學位。

questions.q: 某2026/27學年研究生課程可於橫琴辦學點及澳門主校區上課。實際課堂安排主要由誰決定？
choices: 有關學術單位，並向學生通知安排
研究生院按所有課程的統一時間表獨立指定
申請人在網上報名時的選擇直接決定最終上課安排
questions.why: 官方資訊列明上課安排由有關學術單位決定；申請人可表示是否接受橫琴安排，但不等於自行決定時間表。

questions.q: 如何分辨2026/27學年已開展的橫琴第一期辦學安排與建設中的新合作區校區？
choices: 第一期即是已全面建成的新合作區校區，無須另設新校區
第一期已安排教學；新校區預計2028年部分啟用、2029年全面建成
第一期只提供科研設施，所有相關研究生課程仍須在澳門主校區上課
questions.why: 第一期已支援實際教學及科研，不等同未來新校區已完成；新校區預計2028年部分開放、2029年建成。

questions.q: 研究生院網站的「在讀學生」資訊，哪一組事項最直接相關？
choices: 規章及指引、學歷文件申請、學籍及離校手續
招生批次、博士申請資格、入學面試安排
課程招生活動、國際生源宣傳、入學申請指引
questions.why: 在讀學生欄目聚焦學生在學期間所需的學籍、文件及規章資訊；另外兩組主要是準申請人的招生資訊。

questions.q: 五年規劃預計2030/31學年，全校研究生佔學生總數約多少？
questions.why: 2030/31學年目標約55%；52%為2025/26的實際佔比，56%則出現在部分中期預測學年。

questions.q: 五年規劃表6預計2030/31學年的全校研究生總人數為多少？
五年規劃表6預計2030/31學年，全校兩校區合計學生規模為多少？
按五年規劃表7，兩校區合共規劃多少間研究生住宿書院？
choices: 3間
6間
questions.why: 主校區與合作區校區分別規劃3間研究生書院，共6間；14間是計劃中的本科生書院總數。

questions.q: 哪一組完整對應五年規劃列出的研究生住宿書院主題？
choices: 創新與跨領域交流、卓越研究、全球交流
創新與跨領域交流、學術支援、全球交流
創新與跨領域交流、卓越研究、產業實習
questions.why: 計劃原文列出三個主題：創新與跨領域交流、卓越研究、全球交流；學術支援與產業實習屬相關活動，不是該組主題名稱。

questions.q: 五年規劃在拓展國際碩士生源的段落中，明確舉出哪兩個亞洲國家？
choices: 馬來西亞及泰國
馬來西亞及越南
越南及印尼
questions.why: 規劃在研究生教育部分明確舉出馬來西亞及越南；其他亞洲國家可以是招生市場，但並非該句點名的組合。

questions.q: 哪組措施屬五年規劃明確提出的研究生管理數碼化改革？
choices: 線上博士入學面試評分系統及招生活動轉化率平台
研究生成績自動覆核系統及跨校區住宿配額管理模塊
線上論文典試委員會提交系統及畢業生職業發展追踪模塊
questions.why: 規劃明確提出「線上論文典試委員會提交系統」和「畢業生職業發展追踪模塊」；另外兩組並非該段所列措施。

questions.q: A postgraduate student asks how academic and administrative responsibilities are shared. Which description best matches the Graduate School's published role?
choices: GRS independently sets thesis topics and approves academic supervision arrangements
GRS coordinates admission publicity while academic units alone manage every other aspect of postgraduate education
GRS works with academic units to manage, develop and evaluate postgraduate education
questions.why: GRS has a cross-university coordinating role in graduate education. It does not take over academic supervision or limit its remit solely to recruitment.

questions.q: An applicant intends to be considered for the UM PhD Scholarship (UMPS). At which stage should the funding application normally be submitted?
choices: After receiving the formal PhD admission offer but before registration
At the same time as the online application for PhD admission
After completing the first semester, once a supervisor has assessed research progress
questions.why: UMPS applications are submitted together with the online PhD admission application, not after receiving an offer or starting the programme.

questions.q: An applicant is deciding whether to seek UMPS or UMTRA funding for a second-semester PhD intake. Which official restriction is relevant?
choices: Applications for these two schemes are available only for first-semester admission
UMPS is open for second-semester admission, but UMTRA is restricted to the first semester
UMTRA is open for second-semester admission, but UMPS is restricted to the first semester
questions.why: The GRS funding pages state that applications for both UMPS and UMTRA are available only for first-semester admission.

questions.q: Which statement correctly distinguishes the award cohorts for UMPS and the older UM Macao PhD Scholarship?
choices: UMPS applies from 2022/23 admission; the older scheme covers 2021/22 and earlier
UMPS applies from 2024/25 admission; the older scheme covers 2023/24 and earlier
UMPS applies from 2023/24 admission; the older scheme covers 2022/23 and earlier
questions.why: UMPS applies to students admitted from 2023/24; earlier cohorts fall under the older UM Macao PhD Scholarship framework.

questions.q: For a UMTRA Type B recipient, what determines the stated monthly stipend?
choices: A fixed percentage of the UMPS monthly stipend, irrespective of tuition
The monthly average of the programme's full tuition fees over its normative study period
The difference between the student's accommodation fee and the monthly UMTRA Type A allowance
questions.why: UMTRA Type B is calculated from the programme's total tuition averaged over its normative study period. It is not a fixed fraction of UMPS or an accommodation supplement.

questions.q: An eligible international master's applicant is offered a Type B International Student Scholarship. Which benefit does Type B provide?
choices: A 100% waiver of the master's programme tuition fee
A 100% tuition waiver plus a shared-room accommodation waiver
A waiver of only the international-to-local tuition differential
questions.why: Type B covers full tuition only. The package with accommodation support is Type A; the tuition differential waiver is Type C.

questions.q: How does a Type C International Student Scholarship affect a master's student's tuition?
choices: It waives 50% of the standard international tuition fee
It removes the international tuition differential so the student pays the local tuition rate
It provides a full tuition waiver but no accommodation or assistantship support
questions.why: Type C waives the amount above the local tuition rate. It is different from the full tuition waiver under Type B.

questions.q: An eligible international master's applicant asks whether to submit a scholarship form separately from the admission application. What is the published procedure?
choices: Apply separately for the scholarship immediately after receiving a conditional offer
Apply for admission first, then submit a scholarship form once tuition fees have been assessed
No separate scholarship application is required; eligible applicants are considered during admission evaluation
questions.why: The published International Student Scholarship procedure provides automatic consideration for eligible admission applicants without a separate scholarship form.

questions.q: Which applicant is within the published basic eligibility scope for UM's STEM Scholarship for master's programmes?
choices: A Macao SAR identity-card holder admitted to an eligible STEM master's programme
A mainland applicant admitted to an eligible STEM master's programme who does not hold a Macao SAR identity card
A Macao SAR identity-card holder admitted to a non-STEM master's programme
questions.why: The scholarship targets holders of a Macao SAR resident identity card admitted to selected STEM master's programmes; both residency and discipline matter.

questions.q: A candidate has been recommended by a partner institution for a listed UM Joint PhD Programme. How should the formal UM application proceed?
choices: The partner's recommendation completes UM admission without a separate application
The applicant emails the partner's acceptance letter to UM only after the first year
The candidate still applies through UM's online system within the published application period
questions.why: Partner recommendation does not replace UM's own online PhD admission procedure.

questions.q: What supervision arrangement characterises the listed joint PhD training programmes?
choices: A UM supervisor conducts all research supervision, with the partner acting solely as host
Supervisors at UM and the partner institution provide joint research supervision
The partner alone supervises the thesis, while UM only processes graduation documents
questions.why: The listed joint PhD arrangements involve supervisors from both UM and the cooperating institution, rather than a purely administrative partnership.

questions.q: Which monthly stipend range is stated for the relevant listed Joint PhD training arrangements?
questions.why: The listed range is MOP6,250–12,500 per month. MOP12,500 and MOP20,000 are also amounts associated with other UM doctoral funding schemes, but not this published range.

questions.q: Which of these disciplines is expressly included in the 2026/27 Hengqin first-phase postgraduate teaching arrangements?
choices: Comparative literature
Tourism policy
Artificial intelligence
questions.why: The 2026/27 Hengqin first-phase programme list expressly includes the Master of Science in Artificial Intelligence; the other named areas are not listed there as such.

questions.q: A student is told that classes may be split between the Hengqin first-phase site and UM's main campus. Who decides the actual class arrangement?
choices: The Graduate School alone, using one common timetable across all programmes
The academic unit concerned, which notifies the student on enrolment
The student, by selecting a preferred teaching location in the application form
questions.why: Class locations and schedules are determined by the relevant academic unit. A student's stated willingness to attend Hengqin does not itself set the timetable.

questions.q: Which shared platform is expressly identified for e-learning, attendance checks and assignment submission across the Hengqin and main-campus arrangements?
choices: UMMoodle
The postgraduate online admission portal
The student record and tuition payment portal
questions.why: The Hengqin information page identifies unified UMMoodle access for learning and teaching functions; admissions and student records are distinct administrative systems.

questions.q: Which statement most accurately describes postgraduate teaching arrangements at the Hengqin first-phase site in 2026/27?
choices: Hengqin classes are offered in the evening only, while the main campus is daytime only
Hengqin first-phase classes may be held in the daytime, while main-campus classes may be daytime or evening, subject to academic-unit arrangements
All lectures are in Hengqin, while only examinations and thesis defences are held on the main campus
questions.why: GRS describes daytime classes at the Hengqin first-phase site and daytime or evening classes at the main campus, as determined by the programme's academic unit.

questions.q: According to UM's current five-year plan, when are the new Hengqin Cooperation Zone campus's partial operation and full completion envisaged?
choices: Partial operation in 2027 and full completion in 2028
Partial operation in 2029 and full completion in 2030
Partial operation in 2028 and full completion in 2029
questions.why: The plan identifies 2028 for partial operation and 2029 for full completion. These dates concern the new campus, not existing first-phase teaching arrangements.

questions.q: Under Table 6 of the five-year plan, what is the projected total number of students at the cooperation-zone campus in 2030/31?
questions.why: The 2030/31 total for the cooperation-zone campus is 3,967. The number 2,742 refers to its postgraduate students in that year; 2,184 is the campus's projected total for 2028/29.

questions.q: Under the same projection, how many postgraduate students are expected at the cooperation-zone campus in 2030/31?
questions.why: The forecast is 2,742 postgraduate students in 2030/31. The figure 2,315 is the 2029/30 postgraduate forecast and 3,967 is the total campus enrolment in 2030/31.

questions.q: How many residential colleges across UM's two campuses does the five-year plan envisage in total?
questions.why: The plan sets out 20 residential colleges in total: 12 on the main campus and eight at the cooperation-zone campus.

questions.q: According to Table 7, how many of the planned residential colleges are specifically postgraduate colleges?
choices: Six
Eight
Fourteen
questions.why: The plan specifies three postgraduate colleges per campus, giving six in total. Eight is the total number of colleges on the cooperation-zone campus; fourteen are undergraduate colleges across both campuses.

questions.q: Which change in postgraduate recruitment is expressly prioritised in the five-year plan?
choices: Concentrating recruitment on domestic doctoral students while leaving overseas master's recruitment unchanged
Expanding the international applicant pool for master's programmes and improving admissions processes
Prioritising overseas doctoral joint degrees as the sole route for recruiting international postgraduates
questions.why: The plan explicitly aims to broaden international master's recruitment and strengthen targeted outreach and admissions procedures; doctoral collaboration remains a separate development priority.

questions.q: Which combination of methods best matches the plan's proposed approach to international master's recruitment?
choices: Use broad, untargeted messaging for all programmes and remove in-person experience elements
Rely mainly on existing university exchange agreements without programme-specific recruitment activity
Target selected universities, tailor promotion to programmes and add experience-based elements to recruitment sessions
questions.why: The plan proposes targeted institutions, programme-specific promotion and experience-based sessions, alongside international education fairs and outreach to Asian markets.

questions.q: Which new educational component does the plan specifically propose for doctoral programmes?
choices: A translational research component within PhD training
A compulsory year of overseas study for every PhD student
A uniform industry placement requirement replacing doctoral research methods
questions.why: The plan proposes introducing a translational research unit within doctoral programmes. It does not state that every doctoral student must undertake overseas study or replace research training with placements.

questions.q: What is the main opportunity envisaged through the university-level doctoral research exchange programme?
choices: A guaranteed overseas teaching appointment for every doctoral student
Participation in national-level academic projects and world-class industrial research projects
Automatic conversion from a UM PhD degree to a dual degree with participating universities
questions.why: The plan aims to expand access to major academic and industry research projects through doctoral research exchange, without guaranteeing employment or dual degrees.
